entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This Suo Motu Case is dealt with in an extraordinary manner by the Dedicated Bench, pursuant to Suo Motu W.P.(Crl.) No.618 of 2025.
2.This is a complaint filed by the Food Safety Officer against the accused who is running a Chips Shop.
In this case the accused was said to have sold fried green peas which contained artificial colour found to be unsafe.
The matter has been pending since 2018.
There is no previous or subsequent case against the accused.

3.Considering the factual matrix, context of the case, the antecedents of the accused, the reason for absence from his usual place, and the submission that, despite best efforts, the summons could not be served, it is evident that even if the accused is brought to face trial, it would impinge upon his right to a speedy trial.
Due to the passage of time, a meaningful trial is unlikely, and no useful purpose would be served.

( Uploaded on: 24/11/2025 12:39:58 pm ) D.BHARATHA CHAKRAVARTHY, J.
4.
Accordingly, C.C.No.15104 of 2022 of X Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Egmore Taluk, Chennai stands quashed and this Suo Motu Transfer case is disposed of.
